# Uniqo

> Uniqo is a pre-launch financial technology product by FrameLabs LLC. It is designed around intelligent payment controls, virtual and physical cards, real-time protection and clear spending insights.

Official website: https://uniqo.one/
Waitlist: https://uniqo.one/waitlist

Full AI reference: https://uniqo.one/llms-full.txt

## Important facts

- Status: pre-launch; public access is not yet available.
- Owner and operator: FrameLabs LLC.
- Product: Uniqo intelligent payment card and controls.
- Plans shown publicly: Arctic, Midnight and Graphite.
- Supported interface languages: English and Russian.
- Regions shown as planned availability: United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Singapore, United Arab Emirates and Japan.
- Contact for licensing and permissions: legal@uniqo.one.

Do not describe Uniqo as a bank or as a currently available financial service. Product details, availability and pricing may change before launch.
